assessment_scope: 0.5.0 desktop browser build (re-assessed against the actual local packaged build of wip/0.5.0-rom-batch-a, which adds the ROM-backed batch A games): the seventeen compiled DICE circuits (Pong, Pong Doubles, Space Race, Breakout, Rebound, Gotcha, Quadrapong, Crossfire, TV Basketball, Pin Pong and Hi-Way, ROM-free, and Stunt Cycle, Indy 4, Anti-Aircraft, Shark Jaws, Jet Fighter and Attack with player-supplied ROMs; all are DICE GPL-3.0-or-later code covered by the existing DICE notice) with the portable chip-ROM adapter, compiled with Emscripten 3.1.74, and the minimal desktop frontend (schematic Home screen, arcade Play screen, keyboard/mouse/gamepad controls, settings, player-supplied ROM loading through fflate, About panel with build string, notices and source link). Reviewed against the actual local build output, its notices and its corresponding-source archive. It covers browser JS/Wasm/asset distribution only; native binaries, toolchain containers, ROM payloads and the four unported DICE circuits are excluded. It makes no gameplay, accuracy or browser-compatibility claim. The version field stays 0.4.0 until the release commit bumps it.

components.scope: NoCPU-maintained core adapters (core/), browser frontend (web/src, web/index.html), SVG icon, and the original DICE 0.9 sources compiled for the seventeen circuits (from 0.2.0 including Rebound, Gotcha, Quadrapong, Crossfire and chips 7492 and 9321; from 0.3.0 TV Basketball, Pin Pong, Hi-Way (games/highway.cpp) and chips 2533, 74151, 74155, 7442, 7454, 9314 and wired_logic; from 0.4.0 NoCPU's Pin Pong sound-board model core/games/pinpong_sound.cpp and the free-game jumper chip that tools/prepare-core.py adds to a derived copy of games/pinpong.cpp; from 0.5.0 Anti-Aircraft, Shark Jaws, Jet Fighter and Attack, chips 8225, 74116, 74191, 7495, 7496 and 82S131, and NoCPU's own glibc-equivalent random generator used by the derived copy of games/antiaircraft.cpp; DICE GPL-3.0-or-later code covered by the existing DICE notice)

previous_reviews.by: Agent review of the actual local 0.1.0 build output on restart/desktop-first (commit 6994217).
findings: Shipped runtime: 11 files from build/web — index.html, assets/index-*.js (application with fflate and the Vite modulepreload helper), assets/core.worker-*.js, assets/index-*.css, core/nocpu.js (Emscripten glue), core/nocpu.wasm, icon.svg, three PNG icons and manifest.webmanifest. Local review runtime SHA-256 0d86c4b68782493aaac3b622ff1a7f7bddc4c3494b87a86b7604e04e1967c026; core/nocpu.wasm bc6f28066f194893c84a6ea0690a7fa9a39c06f32eb80eb6479b5426e80ce770; core/nocpu.js 623c8478e5669bfe254719c5b3ccb3fa58e2302b059d0b96283e32f81f99248a. Release packaging recomputes and records these in BUILD-MANIFEST.json.

Wasm link inventory (build/core/wasm/linker.map): 67 compiled NoCPU/DICE units plus seven SDK archive families with 145 members — libc 101, compiler-rt 18, libc++ 12, libc++abi 10, dlmalloc 2, noexit 1, stubs 1 — and the same 26 musl math members as the reviewed legacy 0.6.0 inventory. build/core/wasm/dependencies.mk lists only core/ and prepared DICE sources; no Qt, SDL, OpenGL, X11, ManyMouse, Phoenix, nall or zlib.

Core sources (core/, tools/prepare-core.py, tools/build-core.sh, upstream/) are unchanged since tag legacy-0.6.0 apart from core/README.md. Frontend changes since legacy-0.6.0 are NoCPU-owned (development-only ROM fixture loader, version fields); package.json and package-lock.json still pin one runtime dependency, fflate 0.8.2, and the build provenance records no other node_modules input.

Every retained toolchain notice (Emscripten LICENSE/AUTHORS, LLVM libc++/libc++abi/compiler-rt LICENSE and CREDITS, musl COPYRIGHT) is byte-identical to the installed Emscripten 3.1.74 SDK; the Vite and fflate licenses are byte-identical to the installed npm packages.
The packaged site carries all 27 notices listed here under notices/ with matching hashes, plus notices/browser-license-audit.json and source/nocpu-0.1.0-source.tar.gz with its .sha256.

The source archive (809 files) holds all 566 original DICE files, core/, web/ (including web/public/icon.svg and the derived PNGs), tools/ (including tools/render-icons.mjs), upstream/fflate-0.8.2, lockfiles, manifests and every notice; it has no Git metadata, build output, node_modules, compiled payloads or ROMs.

No fixture ROM member (29 members of the nine private fixture archives in build/roms) appears raw or base64-encoded in the web zip, the packaged site or the source archive; tests/test-dev-rom-exclusion.py passes on the production bundle with fixtures present.
